title: Ryvyt
type: Main member of the Ale-Chemy Knights
imageAlt: Portrait of Ryvyt, Ale-Chemy founder, crafter, and researcher
imageCaption: Ryvyt — Ale-Chemy founder, crafter, and researcher.
dek: A founder and lead crafter whose work turns shared resources into useful equipment, while later discoveries preserve the history of those who handled them before him.

facts.Status: Present and active after the October Babel mist rescue (19 October 2026 UTC source posts).

Quest RP refreshed source · supplied 23 October 2026 · 3,845 messages across the main channel and two accessible threads; posting chronology and narrated continuations remain distinct
body:
Ryvyt is a founder and one of the three main members of the Ale-Chemy Knights. Where Farkur is most visible as the institutional architect, Ryvyt makes specialization operational: crafting, research, shared equipment, and project work that other members cannot simply improvise.

“Our crafter”

On 25 July 2025, Farkur directs Coralyn to Ryvyt when her request passes beyond Farkur’s expertise. The phrase “our crafter” identifies an internal role and a principle of the Knights’ system: the organization becomes stronger by routing work to the right specialist.

Ryvyt requests the Hazewind Cape, Puzzler’s Wit ring, and a Bag of Holding from shared inventory for a job. Ryvyt also asks that project requests be left behind so useful crafting can be completed before departure. These actions show the shop as a shared operational pool rather than a display of private possessions.

Ryvyting Creations

Ryvyt owns and operates Ryvyting Creations in Pristinia. Its early material shortages frustrate him because he wants to use the forge, not merely sell recovered goods. His crafting turns the Knights’ scouting, supply and shared stock into equipment people can use.

The shop synthesis identifies him as lead crafter; Farkur’s playful “King of the Forge” acknowledges that role without creating a rank. At the shop he explains the Knights’ newcomer services and consultative membership process as well as their commercial work. The later retail closure during the shift toward Gael marks a change in the institution’s geography; the shop’s subsequent use remains unestablished.

Research and policy are not the same

Ryvyt has pursued unusual research, including Delerium. That interest belongs to Ryvyt’s record; it should not automatically be treated as Ale-Chemy Knights policy or proof that every member approves of the work.

Founder and main Ale-Chemy Knight

Draven Montauk identifies Farkur and Ryvyt as founders in February 2026 while both are away on an important job. The group later creates Gael’s open-air market, but the surviving synthesis does not assign Ryvyt a particular market office or prove which section Ryvyt built or managed.

On 26 May, Ryvyt arrives at a small island settlement aboard an Ale-Chemy ship and introduces himself as “the remaining founder of the Ale-Chemy Knights.” The narration notes hurt in his broken tone. The wording proves that Ryvyt experiences founder-loss by that date; it does not by itself establish whether Farkur was dead, missing, absent, or no longer active.

The disappearance’s personal cost

Thorn carries news that Farkur and other Knights disappeared and that Ryvyt took it hard. The wording supports grief, distress, or serious personal impact without establishing the exact emotion, words, or response. It also does not place Ryvyt among the missing.

Open record

Ryvyt’s earlier life, relationships with Tobias and Farkur, research outcomes, role in the Gael market, longer-term response after the disappearance and outcomes of his research remain unresolved. Later expeditions around Larkhollow are recorded below.

September–October · investigating Verdelune

Ryvyt’s later source appearances place him on expeditions around Larkhollow rather than among the missing Knights. At Hana’s tower, Oya rescues him when he falls. He returns with Pelagia to ask residents questions, then brings Fenwick, Saelihn and Trougar to the old road and monument described by Ilyra.

At Viota’s monument he urges restraint around a watching child. He proposes bringing a druid to help and asks that recovered items be documented. The proposal is unfinished; his careful fieldwork does not establish faction-wide policy or a solved forest mystery.

Scene sources: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6.

The direct route to the Lunar Tear

Boggun and Ryvyt push straight through thick woodland during the Lunar Tear expedition. Boggun lends Ryvyt a hand axe; fallen trees then slow them both. Ryvyt hears their companions in trouble and the pair hurry through the trees to rejoin the battle. The branch explains the split party’s return without implying they discovered the Tear on their own.

Scene evidence: 1, 2, 3, 4.

Defenses built by many hands

The April 2024 description presents the walls as unfinished but already improved by many workers. Alyhotep uses earth-shaping magic, with animals hauling materials; Ryvyt follows others’ work with Mending to correct imperfections. There is no basis here for assigning the whole defense to one founder. Earlier completion accounts and later construction references should be read as layers of work, repair and expansion rather than one final date for every fortification.

Scene evidence: 1, 2, 3.

May 2025 · skill meets a material limit

Ryvyt’s early workshop requests are practical: bring the materials and an idea of the desired item. His willingness to craft is conditional on supply. He waits for the materials list, directs deliveries to a basket and identifies a need for scouts who can find resources the hunters do not provide.

The shortage changes what useful exploration means. Recipes, available stock, scouting and transport have to meet at the forge before expertise can become equipment. Ryvyt’s role is therefore specialist work inside a network, rather than an assertion that he personally performs every stage.

An owned shop with shared work

Ryvyting Creations is Ryvyt’s shop, as established in its existing ownership record. The Knights’ shared stock, loans, individual goods and commercial activity remain distinct from that property ownership. Owning the premises does not make every item passing through them his private possession.

Ryvyt and Farkur bring complementary work to the same organization. Crafting depends on records, sales and incoming components; those systems depend in turn on useful objects. Tobias’s construction and newcomer support belong alongside this work, not beneath a claim that one member alone made the Knights function.

December 2025 · explaining the work himself

Ryvyt calls himself the Knights’ lead crafter and describes crafting and sales. He also explains their contributions to Pristinia and their provision of information and island maps to newcomers. Public service is something he describes in his own voice, rather than only a program attributed to Farkur.

That account supports his role and the organization’s stated work. It does not establish a monopoly on magical trade or prove every item and spell offered was his creation.

Craft and investigation

Minerva comes to the workshop seeking Ryvyt for further Delerium experiments. The scene establishes the proposed collaboration, not that an experiment was safe, successful or approved as policy by every Knight. Research remains a distinct part of his record.

A later condition makes old knowledge visible

The established grimoire history connects Papirak, Stash, Fredrick, the Ale-Chemy stocks and later investigators. Ryvyt’s use of Truesight, with Jiangshi present, reveals hidden spells that earlier examinations did not make accessible.

His contribution is the perceptual condition and the discovery, not authorship of the spells. Fredrick’s blank-looking pages and Minerva’s unsuccessful examination remain what they could observe at the time. The later result enlarges the history without turning earlier limits into incompetence.

The work beyond the storefront

The existing shop history records retail closing as the Knights turn toward Gael and cannot staff the Pristinia premises. This is a concrete operational limit, not proof of a failed craft career or that the building was abandoned permanently.

Ryvyt’s founder-loss testimony and Thorn’s account of the disappearance remain distinct from the shop’s closure. Neither places him among the missing or settles the fate of the others. His later market responsibilities, research outcomes and complete personal chronology remain unresolved.

Recorded workshop scenes

Dates identify transcript postings, not an in-world calendar.

  • 7 May 2025 · materials and requests
  • Crafting depends on supply
  • A place for incoming materials
  • 12 May · scouting for resources
  • Waiting for the stock list
  • 22 December · lead crafter
  • Information and maps for arrivals
  • 1 July · Minerva seeks further experiments

October · the remedies that worked, and those that did not

New to this part of Babel, Ryvyt asks for a briefing and brings elixirs and stored healing magic. During the salamander ambush he gets Olokun conscious again and uses Lesser Restoration to remove the paralysis. The company’s escape depends on this practical preparation as well as its attacks.

The narrator initially exempts Ryvyt from the fog because he does not breathe. That ruling lets him recognize Olokun’s altered state, but does not establish immunity to every danger in the region. Greater Restoration has no effect on Olokun here. His fan disperses some mist only momentarily before it creeps back.

Dispel Magic succeeds on Nymera. The narrator explicitly places her release before Scribonia’s Wish, preserving two contributions to the rescue. Ryvyt then reassures and heals companions, carries Olokun and checks the failing Scribonia. He also refuses Death’s offer. His achievement includes trying, noticing failure and changing remedies, rather than discovering one cure for everything the mist can do.

Helping people across the river

Ryvyt greets Lirael as a friend and plays her a farewell tune before guiding the party north. When Pin is drawn to the river, he grabs and pulls him back, but cannot prevent the seven-year aging that follows. Later he supplies flight elixirs so the company can cross without fighting the creatures on the mountain.

At the Dark Shroud he fights, heals Fenwick and helps restore Minerva after she falls. He accepts her choice to negotiate. The eventual release of Selwyn’s body is distinct from a completed restoration or a safe return by everyone.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8.

Scenes in sequence

These selected scenes preserve what was knowable when people acted. Dates below identify source postings in UTC; they do not supply an in-world calendar. A later appearance does not settle present status.

  1. 2024-05-06 · quest

    Repair as a civic contribution

    Ryvyt describes following the wall builders and using Mending on their work.

    Known at this stage
    His statement concerns reinforcement and hidden weaknesses.
    Consequence
    The wall’s history includes repair and maintenance beside construction.
    Still unresolved
    The account does not make him its only builder.

    Receipt 1

  2. 2025-05-12 · compatible RP

    Skill needs a supply network

    Ryvyt asks for scouts to gather plants, relics and usable stone or metal.

    Known at this stage
    The workshop needs materials that cannot be supplied by skill alone.
    Consequence
    Crafting connects the shop to exploration and other people’s labor.
    Still unresolved
    A request does not prove the materials were delivered.

    Receipt 1

  3. 2026-05-27 · quest

    A founder speaks after loss

    Ryvyt introduces himself as the remaining Ale-Chemy Knights founder; the post marks his hurt.

    Known at this stage
    This is how he presents his position at that moment.
    Consequence
    Founder identity carries grief as well as institutional continuity.
    Still unresolved
    Remaining does not independently determine the fate of every other founder.

    Receipt 1

  4. 2026-10-19 · quest

    Preparation keeps Olokun in the fight

    Ryvyt heals Olokun and uses Lesser Restoration after the salamander paralyzes and badly wounds him.

    Known at this stage
    He asked for a briefing and prepared remedies before leaving the refuge.
    Consequence
    The company can keep fighting because a companion has brought more than offensive power.
    Still unresolved
    This success treats the salamander’s paralysis, not every later effect in the mist.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3 · Receipt 4 · Receipt 5

  5. 2026-10-19 · quest

    A failed remedy followed by a successful dispelling

    Greater Restoration fails on Olokun, wind shifts the mist only briefly, and Dispel Magic frees Nymera before the Wish.

    Known at this stage
    The narrator temporarily exempts nonbreathing Ryvyt from the mist’s effect.
    Consequence
    A bounded success belongs to Ryvyt even though Scribonia later clears the wider area.
    Still unresolved
    The result does not establish blanket immunity or that either spell always succeeds or fails against every mist effect.

profile.personality: Ryvyt is a crafter, researcher, and operational thinker who makes specialization real. Rather than treating every problem as something one charismatic leader should solve, Ryvyt borrows the right shared equipment, takes on project work, and gives the Knights a place where unusual expertise can become communal capacity.
profile.achievements: A founder and lead crafter whose work turns shared resources into useful equipment, while later discoveries preserve the history of those who handled them before him. Pulls Pin from the river’s compulsion, supplies a way across and heals companions in the Selwyn encounter.
profile.relationships: Farkur is the relationship around which Ryvyt’s public history turns: collaborator, co-founder, and later absence. Tobias completes the recognized trio of main Knights, while Coralyn’s request demonstrates how others rely on Ryvyt when work exceeds Farkur’s expertise. Reports that Ryvyt took the disappearances hard establish real grief without inventing the words or later choices the archive has not recovered.
